driver.find_element(AppiumBy.ID, 'com.simplemobiletools.smsmessenger:id/thread_send_message').click()
WebDriverWait(driver, 10).until(lambda d: bool(d.find_elements(AppiumBy.ANDROID_UIAUTOMATOR, 'new UiSelector().text("Beauty is in the eye of the beholder.")')))
observe()
